{#- The theme control, the landing page's (`docs/landing/src/shell.html`): one round button with two states and no third (WP-2021). The page follows the system until a click pins the other theme. pydata's own switcher is a three-item menu, so this replaces it. The glyph is CSS: the sun and the moon are `only-light` and `only-dark`, which pydata hides by `html[data-theme]`. The click is `_static/rietx-theme.js`, which writes the keys pydata reads, so the theme engine underneath is still pydata's. Hidden without script, as pydata's is, by `pst-js-only`. -#}
